title: Whether Harris played with Dawson; his father's death in 1930
summary: Harris never played with old man Dawson; his father died in 1930 aged about 46.

blocks.x: Oh. Can I just, uh, see what you've got man?

Oh yeah, tell me. Did you, did you ever play with old man Dawson? No, I never had a chance to play with old man Dawson. I played a lot of my daddy's friends but I never, I don't remember playing with him. Well, when did your father die about?
In 1930. I think my daddy was about 46 or 45 or 46 years old. Born back in the 1880s then I guess. Yeah.
